name: Raw Materials

pages.text: Raw resources can be automatically gathered by the Forester, Miner, and Quarrier workers. They are essential when scaling up the production lines of any non agricultural good
The Forester collects wood in a large area around it's building, collecting and replanting saplings when available.
Even if the forester cannot cut the entire tree in one go, not to worry, they have infinite vertical range and eventually will cut down the tallest trees too.
They can use scythes to speed up the collection of saplings, or shears to collect leaf blocks intact. You can also define a specific zone for them to cut wood at.
The Miner collects stone, ores and minerals. They also place torches and cobblestone slabs to make the mineshaft safer.
the torches they place are automatically re-lit when they are nearby, They also generate a small amount of bonus metals from mining normal stone blocks even when they can't find actual ores.

The Quarrier can be hired from the same building, he mines entire pits instead of creating a mineshaft focusing on collecting wast amounts of stone. The Miners hut can only employ one kind of worker at a time
